<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="M365 Copilot" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="ingestion-metadata-erd" name="Data Ingestion Metadata ERD"> <mxGraphModel dx="1031" dy="417" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1800" pageHeight="1100" background="#F5F7FA" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "erDiagram

 WORKSPACE {
 uuid id PK
 string name
 uuid tenant_id
 timestamptz created_at
 }

 DATASET {
 uuid id PK
 uuid workspace_id FK
 string name
 text description
 string created_by
 string status
 int current_version
 timestamptz created_at
 timestamptz updated_at
 }

 DATASET_VERSION {
 uuid id PK
 uuid dataset_id FK
 int version_number
 string schema_hash
 string created_by
 timestamptz created_at
 }

 DATASET_FILE {
 uuid id PK
 uuid dataset_version_id FK
 string original_filename
 string file_format
 string mime_type
 bigint file_size_bytes
 string object_key
 string storage_bucket
 string checksum
 string uploaded_by
 timestamptz uploaded_at
 }

 DATASET_COLUMN {
 uuid id PK
 uuid dataset_version_id FK
 string column_name
 string source_data_type
 string logical_data_type
 int ordinal_position
 boolean nullable
 int precision_value
 int scale_value
 string format_pattern
 }

 INGESTION_JOB {
 uuid id PK
 uuid dataset_version_id FK
 uuid dataset_file_id FK
 string status
 string processor_type
 string external_job_id
 string submitted_by
 timestamptz submitted_at
 timestamptz started_at
 timestamptz completed_at
 string error_code
 text error_message
 int attempt_number
 }

 INGESTION_METRICS {
 uuid ingestion_job_id PK, FK
 bigint rows_read
 bigint rows_written
 bigint rows_rejected
 bigint duplicate_rows
 int column_count
 bigint input_bytes
 bigint output_bytes
 bigint processing_duration_ms
 string delta_table_path
 timestamptz captured_at
 }

 INGESTION_STATUS_HISTORY {
 bigint id PK
 uuid ingestion_job_id FK
 string from_status
 string to_status
 text message
 string changed_by
 timestamptz changed_at
 }

 COLUMN_PROFILE {
 uuid id PK
 uuid ingestion_job_id FK
 uuid dataset_column_id FK
 bigint null_count
 bigint distinct_count
 text min_value
 text max_value
 decimal mean_value
 timestamptz profiled_at
 }

 WORKSPACE ||--o{ DATASET : owns

 DATASET ||--o{ DATASET_VERSION : has

 DATASET_VERSION ||--o{ DATASET_FILE : contains

 DATASET_VERSION ||--o{ DATASET_COLUMN : defines

 DATASET_VERSION ||--o{ INGESTION_JOB : executes

 DATASET_FILE ||--o{ INGESTION_JOB : processed_by

 INGESTION_JOB ||--o| INGESTION_METRICS : generates

 INGESTION_JOB ||--o{ INGESTION_STATUS_HISTORY : records

 INGESTION_JOB ||--o{ COLUMN_PROFILE : produces

 DATASET_COLUMN ||--o{ COLUMN_PROFILE : profiled_as",

 "data": "erDiagram

 %% =========================================================
 %% IDENTITY AND ORGANIZATION
 %% =========================================================

 TENANT {
 string id PK
 string name
 string plan
 string environment
 datetime created_at
 }

 APP_USER {
 string id PK
 string keycloak_id UK
 string username UK
 string email
 string display_name
 string avatar
 string designation
 string department
 string status
 string tenant_id FK
 string team_id FK
 datetime created_at
 datetime last_login_at
 }

 TEAM {
 string id PK
 string tenant_id FK
 string name
 datetime created_at
 }

 USER_GROUP {
 bigint id PK
 string code UK
 string name
 string tenant_id FK
 datetime created_at
 }

 USER_GROUP_MEMBER {
 bigint group_id PK,FK
 string user_id PK,FK
 datetime added_at
 string added_by_user_id FK
 }

 WORKSPACE {
 string id PK
 string tenant_id FK
 string name
 string description
 string status
 string created_by_user_id FK
 datetime created_at
 datetime updated_at
 }

 WORKSPACE_MEMBER {
 bigint id PK
 string workspace_id FK
 string user_id FK
 string workspace_role
 boolean is_default
 datetime joined_at
 string added_by_user_id FK
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% DATASET CATALOG
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET {
 string id PK
 string workspace_id FK
 string owner_user_id FK
 string name
 string description
 string status
 int current_version
 string visibility
 datetime created_at
 datetime updated_at
 datetime deleted_at
 }

 DATASET_VERSION {
 string id PK
 string dataset_id FK
 int version_number
 string schema_hash
 string status
 string created_by_user_id FK
 datetime created_at
 }

 DATASET_FILE {
 string id PK
 string dataset_version_id FK
 string uploaded_by_user_id FK
 string original_filename
 string file_format
 string mime_type
 bigint file_size_bytes
 string storage_bucket
 string object_key
 string checksum
 string checksum_algorithm
 datetime uploaded_at
 }

 DATASET_COLUMN {
 string id PK
 string dataset_version_id FK
 string column_name
 string source_data_type
 string logical_data_type
 int ordinal_position
 boolean nullable
 int precision_value
 int scale_value
 string format_pattern
 string description
 datetime created_at
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% INGESTION EXECUTION
 %% =========================================================

 INGESTION_JOB {
 string id PK
 string dataset_version_id FK
 string dataset_file_id FK
 string submitted_by_user_id FK
 string status
 string processor_type
 string external_job_id
 int attempt_number
 datetime submitted_at
 datetime started_at
 datetime completed_at
 string error_code
 string error_message
 }

 INGESTION_METRICS {
 string ingestion_job_id PK,FK
 bigint rows_read
 bigint rows_written
 bigint rows_rejected
 bigint duplicate_rows
 int column_count
 bigint input_bytes
 bigint output_bytes
 bigint processing_duration_ms
 string delta_table_path
 datetime captured_at
 }

 INGESTION_STATUS_HISTORY {
 bigint id PK
 string ingestion_job_id FK
 string from_status
 string to_status
 string message
 string changed_by_user_id FK
 datetime changed_at
 }

 COLUMN_PROFILE {
 string id PK
 string ingestion_job_id FK
 string dataset_column_id FK
 bigint null_count
 bigint distinct_count
 string min_value
 string max_value
 decimal mean_value
 decimal standard_deviation
 datetime profiled_at
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% USER-LEVEL DATASET SHARING
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET_USER_ACCESS {
 string id PK
 string dataset_id FK
 string user_id FK
 string access_level
 boolean can_share
 boolean can_download
 boolean can_upload_new_version
 boolean can_delete
 string granted_by_user_id FK
 datetime granted_at
 datetime expires_at
 datetime revoked_at
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% TEAM-LEVEL DATASET SHARING
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET_TEAM_ACCESS {
 string id PK
 string dataset_id FK
 string team_id FK
 string access_level
 boolean can_share
 boolean can_download
 boolean can_upload_new_version
 boolean can_delete
 string granted_by_user_id FK
 datetime granted_at
 datetime expires_at
 datetime revoked_at
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% GROUP-LEVEL DATASET SHARING
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET_GROUP_ACCESS {
 string id PK
 string dataset_id FK
 bigint group_id FK
 string access_level
 boolean can_share
 boolean can_download
 boolean can_upload_new_version
 boolean can_delete
 string granted_by_user_id FK
 datetime granted_at
 datetime expires_at
 datetime revoked_at
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% OWNERSHIP HISTORY
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET_OWNER_HISTORY {
 string id PK
 string dataset_id FK
 string previous_owner_user_id FK
 string new_owner_user_id FK
 string changed_by_user_id FK
 string change_reason
 datetime changed_at
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% DATASET TAGGING
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET_TAG {
 string id PK
 string tenant_id FK
 string name
 string color
 string created_by_user_id FK
 datetime created_at
 }

 DATASET_TAG_MAPPING {
 string dataset_id PK,FK
 string tag_id PK,FK
 string assigned_by_user_id FK
 datetime assigned_at
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% USER FAVORITES
 %% =========================================================

 USER_DATASET_FAVORITE {
 string user_id PK,FK
 string dataset_id PK,FK
 datetime created_at
 }

 %% =========================================================
 %% RELATIONSHIPS: TENANT AND ORGANIZATION
 %% =========================================================

 TENANT ||--o{ APP_USER : contains
 TENANT ||--o{ TEAM : owns
 TENANT ||--o{ USER_GROUP : owns
 TENANT ||--o{ WORKSPACE : owns
 TENANT ||--o{ DATASET_TAG : defines

 TEAM ||--o{ APP_USER : contains

 APP_USER ||--o{ USER_GROUP_MEMBER : belongs_to
 USER_GROUP ||--o{ USER_GROUP_MEMBER : contains

 APP_USER ||--o{ WORKSPACE_MEMBER : joins
 WORKSPACE ||--o{ WORKSPACE_MEMBER : has

 APP_USER ||--o{ WORKSPACE : creates

 %% =========================================================
 %% RELATIONSHIPS: DATASET AND INGESTION
 %% =========================================================

 WORKSPACE ||--o{ DATASET : contains
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET : owns

 DATASET ||--o{ DATASET_VERSION : has
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_VERSION : creates

 DATASET_VERSION ||--o{ DATASET_FILE : contains
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_FILE : uploads

 DATASET_VERSION ||--o{ DATASET_COLUMN : defines

 DATASET_VERSION ||--o{ INGESTION_JOB : processed_by
 DATASET_FILE ||--o{ INGESTION_JOB : used_by
 APP_USER ||--o{ INGESTION_JOB : submits

 INGESTION_JOB ||--o| INGESTION_METRICS : generates
 INGESTION_JOB ||--o{ INGESTION_STATUS_HISTORY : records
 APP_USER ||--o{ INGESTION_STATUS_HISTORY : changes

 INGESTION_JOB ||--o{ COLUMN_PROFILE : produces
 DATASET_COLUMN ||--o{ COLUMN_PROFILE : profiled_as

 %% =========================================================
 %% RELATIONSHIPS: USER SHARING
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET ||--o{ DATASET_USER_ACCESS : shared_directly
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_USER_ACCESS : receives_access
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_USER_ACCESS : grants_user_access

 %% =========================================================
 %% RELATIONSHIPS: TEAM SHARING
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET ||--o{ DATASET_TEAM_ACCESS : shared_with_team
 TEAM ||--o{ DATASET_TEAM_ACCESS : receives_access
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_TEAM_ACCESS : grants_team_access

 %% =========================================================
 %% RELATIONSHIPS: GROUP SHARING
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET ||--o{ DATASET_GROUP_ACCESS : shared_with_group
 USER_GROUP ||--o{ DATASET_GROUP_ACCESS : receives_access
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_GROUP_ACCESS : grants_group_access

 %% =========================================================
 %% RELATIONSHIPS: OWNERSHIP HISTORY
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET ||--o{ DATASET_OWNER_HISTORY : tracks_ownership
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_OWNER_HISTORY : previous_owner
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_OWNER_HISTORY : new_owner
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_OWNER_HISTORY : changes_owner

 %% =========================================================
 %% RELATIONSHIPS: TAGS AND FAVORITES
 %% =========================================================

 DATASET ||--o{ DATASET_TAG_MAPPING : tagged_with
 DATASET_TAG ||--o{ DATASET_TAG_MAPPING : assigned_to
 APP_USER ||--o{ DATASET_TAG_MAPPING : assigns

 APP_USER ||--o{ USER_DATASET_FAVORITE : bookmarks
 DATASET ||--o{ USER_DATASET_FAVORITE : favorited_by",
